source_title: Maharashtra FDA completes proceedings against SRK, Ajay, and Tiger over pan masala ads

FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe said on Friday that the investigation found the actors had violated state rules. The case will now move to adjudication next week.FDA says investigation has concludedAccording to the PTI report, Tukaram Mundhe told reporters that the three actors had asked for time to respond. The proceedings have now concluded, and the case will be proposed for adjudication before the joint commissioner, who is the competent authority, by next week,â Tukaram Mundhe said.What is adjudication?Adjudication is a quasi-judicial process in which regulators examine evidence and decide whether laws have been broken. It lets authorities impose penalties for non-criminal offences without going through long court proceedings.Ajay Devgn approaches Bombay High CourtTukaram Mundhe said Devgn has moved the Bombay High Court in connection with the matter. He added that the department will carry on with its proceedings before the joint commissioner despite this.Earlier notices over surrogate advertisingThe FDA had earlier sent notices to the three actors over their advertisements for Vimal Elaichi. It alleged that the campaign amounted to surrogate advertising for banned pan masala products. According to the FDA, the brand was linked to the sale of gutkha and pan masala, which are prohibited in Maharashtra.The authority had asked the actors to explain their association with the ads and take steps to stop the promotional campaigns.
